steps.title: 1. Given ADMIN-A has tile record 101 loaded; the fixture provides category Cashflow
2. When ADMIN-A types "Cash" into the combobox labelled "Aplication Category" in the dialog with title text "edit ID: 101" on the administration page
3. And ADMIN-A presses "ArrowDown" on the combobox labelled "Aplication Category" in the dialog with title text "edit ID: 101" on the administration page
4. Then The option labelled "Cashflow" in the popup list for "Aplication Category" on the administration page is highlighted
5. When ADMIN-A presses "Enter" on the combobox labelled "Aplication Category" in the dialog with title text "edit ID: 101" on the administration page
6. Then The combobox labelled "Aplication Category" in the dialog with title text "edit ID: 101" on the administration page has value equal to "Cashflow"
